user_saw: On Twilio conversation calls without media streams, callers could miss the greeting and get disconnected after about five seconds of silence following a reply.
summary: The fix sends Twilio fallback speech and listening in a single live update and uses signed webhook redirects to renew listening after silence while preserving turn tokens.
reasoning: The code before July 5 already sent a second live TwiML update after the greeting and used Gather without a timeout override or silence redirect. PR #100255 added automatic replies to webhook transcripts, which exposed the existing Gather behavior after those replies, while the September persistence refactor retained the separate listening update. Local history stops before the greeting sequence and Gather behavior were introduced, so I could not establish whether either had previously worked.
